title: @mindset__design — MUTUALS: designers show their screens
note: A video project with a simple challenge — designers share their screens and show how they actually use AI to build stuff: show what you made, then show how you did it. Five designers in the pilot. Her steal: the premise is her Draw It -> Ship It ethos in show form, and the format is copyable in one person, one room, zero props — a ready format for her own tools/skills posts.
